question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
gold_answer: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.
candidate_answer:
SBCERS scores respondents to its global custody RFP on four criteria:

| Evaluation criterion | Weight |
|---|---:|
| Scope affirmation, servicing approach, and institutional credentials | 30% |
| Core and value-added services and technology platforms | 40% |
| Quality of responses and additional evidence of capability | 5% |
| Competitiveness and reasonableness of economics | 25% |

Fees are assessed relative to service quality; SBCERS is **not required to select the lowest-cost respondent**. Source: [SBCERS Global Custody RFP, Section V, p. 27](SBCERS__01_2023-SBCERS-Custody-RFP-CONSOLIDATED-Final-Updated.pdf#page=27).
